text: Final categorization: POSSIBLE (Justification: The paper is a non-review research article that uses land use data—specifically deforestation and afforestation trends—as part of a broader systemic analysis of energy and economic transitions. Land use change is discussed (e.g., Figure 3 shows deforestation as a function of GDP/capita), but it is not the primary focus of the study, nor is LULC prediction the central research question. The GCDB method incorporates FAO land use data alongside energy and economic data to support scenario analysis, but the paper does not implement spatially explicit national-scale LULC modeling, produce mapped LULC projections, or apply quantitative accuracy metrics to land use predictions. Instead, land use serves as an illustrative input within a macro-level trend analysis. Thus, while LULC-related data are used, they are incidental to the core objective of analyzing systemic transitions in energy and economy.)
